mapper.select:
SELECT m.*, u.username, u.phone FROM t_merchant m LEFT JOIN t_user u ON m.user_id = u.id
AND m.status = #{status}
AND (m.shop_name LIKE CONCAT('%',#{keyword},'%') OR u.username LIKE CONCAT('%',#{keyword},'%'))
ORDER BY m.id
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO t_merchant (user_id, shop_name, shop_desc, address, license_no, status) VALUES (#{userId}, #{shopName}, #{shopDesc}, #{address}, #{licenseNo}, 0)
mapper.update: UPDATE t_merchant SET status = #{status} WHERE id = #{id}
